title: Missing his first show: sick in Philadelphia
summary: With Willie Bryant's band in Philadelphia, Thomas got sick with pneumonia or flu and missed his first show, and Bryant paid him. Babe notes that on Sundays they played Camden.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
